Overview

Estelí is a city in ES with a population of 100,000. A northern highland city known for its tobacco industry, producing some of the world’s finest cigars. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
